## Work Ethic & Engineering Principles

2. **Tactile & Expressive UI**: Clean typography (Syne, Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono) paired with thoughtful micro-interactions.
3. **Cross-Device Reliability**: Thoroughly tested across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
